The SvelteKit server needs the backend address at runtime. Vite itself does not need backend routing configuration.

- [`frontend/vite.config.ts:4`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/vite.config.ts:4) registers SvelteKit and adapter-node, with dev/preview listening addresses. It defines no backend URL or proxy. There is no separate Svelte config file.
- [`+page.server.ts:10`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:10) reads `process.env.EXPOSED_API_ORIGIN` for each server load, defaulting to `http://127.0.0.1:6999`. It passes that origin into search and detail loaders.
- [`search.ts:104`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/server/search.ts:104) fetches `${origin}/search`; [`entity-details.ts:197`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/server/entity-details.ts:197) fetches `${origin}/members/...` or `/funders/...`. These are server requests. The browser receives the resulting page model via [`+page.svelte:4`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.svelte:4).
- For development, set the environment variable on the Vite process if the default is wrong. Compose already sets `http://exposed:6999` at [`compose.yaml:9`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/compose.yaml:9).
- Building produces the Node server; the backend address belongs to the running server, not a browser bundle or build-time setting. [`README.md:197`](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/README.md:197) documents `EXPOSED_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:6999 node build`. The same server-side loader handles dev and production requests.
